purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for execution context, requester/auth refs, deadlines, propagation and detached/background jobs.

owns: Execution Context and Deadline Monitor semantics

topics.name: Execution Context and Deadline Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for execution context, requester/auth refs, deadlines, propagation and detached/background jobs.

semantics.identity_rule: Context, requester, auth evidence, request, execution and background-job identities remain distinct.
semantics.redaction_rule: Secrets and sensitive auth material are never rendered.
semantics.action_rule: cancel/revoke/recheck-auth operations invoke separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing context grants no operation authority.
semantics.failure_rule: expired/unknown auth, missing context and deadline-exceeded remain explicit.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: background job appears parentless without provenance

references.purpose: Monitor projects exact execution context snapshots.
